waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: take-handed
mutations.why: #takeOver also takes a call a connection was handed (drops the `delivered` check): A runs it too.

mutations.name: replay-before-hub
mutations.why: B drops a kept report when it sends the replay, not when A answers it: a replay the link lost is gone.
mutations.search:
/\ delivered' = [c \in Calls |-> delivered[c] \/ c \in again]
    /\ link' = "up"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, replies, aJournal, runs, kept, toldKept, hub, sleeps, crashes>>
mutations.replace:
/\ delivered' = [c \in Calls |-> delivered[c] \/ c \in again]
    /\ link' = "up"
    /\ kept' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, replies, aJournal, runs, toldKept, hub, sleeps, crashes>>

mutations.name: no-journal-on-a
mutations.why: A runs a re-sent call without its journal: a call it ran before the link dropped runs again.
mutations.search: runs' = IF m[2] \in aJournal THEN runs ELSE [runs EXCEPT ![m[2]] = @ + 1]

mutations.name: hub-no-dedup
mutations.why: The hub's bridge keeps a report whose id it already holds.

mutations.name: no-replay
mutations.why: A re-attach sends no kept report: they stay in the outbox for good.

mutations.name: no-resend-handed
mutations.why: The same tab's re-attach skips a call a dead connection was handed.

mutations.name: no-takeover
mutations.why: Nothing on B carries a call out while A is away.
